children: XPartners strengthens its Danish platform within infrastructure, climate adaptation and drainage by welcoming kLAR Miljørådgivning ApS to the group. The company adds specialist expertise in wastewater, stormwater management and infrastructure, with an established position among Danish water utilities, municipalities and private clients.

kLAR Miljørådgivning was founded in 2019 and today has around 20 employees at its offices in Hinnerup near Aarhus and in Viborg. The company advises across the full project cycle, from design and authority dialogue to tendering, project management, site supervision and handover. Its work covers wastewater, separation of wastewater and stormwater, rehabilitation of pipe networks, pressurised systems and land development, as well as climate adaptation, LAR solutions and infrastructure projects with associated drainage. Revenue in the most recent financial year amounted to approximately DKK 16 million.

“The Danish drainage infrastructure faces substantial investment. Pipe networks are ageing, requirements are tightening, and cities need to adapt to heavier rainfall events. kLAR has built a strong position in exactly that work, and the company markedly strengthens our capabilities within drainage, climate adaptation and infrastructure in Denmark,” says

Clients are primarily Danish water utilities and municipalities, complemented by private clients within infrastructure and land development. Assignments range from stormwater management in new urban districts to separation and rehabilitation of existing pipe networks. In the most recent financial year, the company worked with more than 130 clients and over 250 projects, with its centre of gravity in Jutland.

“We are delighted to be joining XPartners. We share the same values on how a consultancy should be run, with individual responsibility and decisions made close to the client. At the same time, we gain a strong partner and a network of specialist companies around us, which means we can offer our clients more advisory services than we can manage on our own,” say

kLAR Miljørådgivning ApS is a Danish consultancy within environmental and civil engineering, with offices in Hinnerup and Viborg. Founded in 2019, the company works with wastewater, stormwater management, LAR and climate adaptation, as well as roads and civil works, including surveying, design, authority dialogue, tendering, project management and site supervision. Its clients are mainly Danish water utilities, municipalities and private clients.

XPartners Group AB (publ) is a European engineering and design consulting group. The company brings together 2,400 specialists who advise clients across infrastructure, buildings, energy, and the environment. It consists of approximately 90 entrepreneur-led companies supported by a shared platform for collaboration and growth. On a pro forma basis, annual net sales amount to SEK 5 billion and the company is primarily owned by its employees, with backing from the private equity firm Axcel. www.XPartnersGroup.com
Arvid Linder, Chief Communications Officer, XPartners
